title_en: From Potential New Looks at Avengers: Doomsday to Star Wars and Pixar, Here Is Every Massive Reveal From the Disney D23 2026 Entertainment Showcase
summary_en: Follow our live coverage of the Disney D23 2026 Entertainment Showcase. We are tracking every potential announcement, trailer, and exclusive from Marvel, Star Wars, Pixar, and more.
body_en:
D23: Disney's ultimate fan celebration is back. IGN is on the ground all weekend bringing you the biggest news, exclusive content, deep dives and more. Tonight, the show kicks off with the Disney Entertainment showcase. The presentation will feature reveals from the next two years of Disney's theatrical and streaming slate. That potentially means news about X-Men, Star Wars, Frozen 3, and more.
D23 has already seen a new trailer for Disney+'s LEGO Mandarlorian animated special, a look at a new Avatar ride at Disney's California Adventure, a first look at Mystique and Nigthcrawler's costumes from Avengers: Doomsday, and more .
Follow along starting at 7pm PT / 10pm ET for all of the latest updates from what's sure to be a massive showcase.
